verdict.rationale: Keycloak is self-hosted: you run the container image or Kubernetes operator on your own infrastructure. The docs tell you to switch to your own production database such as PostgreSQL. User data can also stay in existing LDAP/AD or custom stores through user federation. Together, these let the operator decide exactly where identity data lives. Missing for 10: explicit data-residency/region documentation, per-realm or multi-region data placement guidance, independent corroboration focused on residency.
